Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.store

Class TerminologyStoreSchema

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.store.TerminologyStoreSchema
public final class TerminologyStoreSchema extends Object
Defines the on-disk layout of the terminology store: the store format version, the names of the Delta tables, and the schema of the manifest. Each table is a Delta table in a subdirectory of the store's root path.
Author:
John Grimes

  • Method Details

    • systemVersionId

      @Nonnull public static String systemVersionId(@Nonnull String url, @Nonnull String version)
      Derives the stable identifier of a code system version from its URL and version. This is the partition key of every content table, so that versions coexist and replace atomically.
      Parameters:
      url - the code system canonical URL
      version - the code system version
      Returns:
      a short hexadecimal hash of the URL and version

    • tablePath

      @Nonnull public static String tablePath(@Nonnull String storagePath, @Nonnull String tableName)
      Returns the path to a table within a store.
      Parameters:
      storagePath - the root path of the store
      tableName - the table name (one of the constants in this class)
      Returns:
      the fully qualified path to the table

    • resourceTableSchema

      @Nonnull public static StructType resourceTableSchema()
      Returns the Spark schema of a resource table (value_set or concept_map), which stores each imported FHIR resource as JSON keyed by its canonical URL and version.
      Returns:
      the resource table schema

    • manifestSchema

      @Nonnull public static StructType manifestSchema()
      Returns the Spark schema of the manifest table.
      Returns:
      the manifest schema
